scope: Phase 0 Gate B renderer research harness
redistribution: No external map tiles, vendor assets, real captures, or copied source are redistributed by the harness.

sources.name: OpenLayers API index
sources.redistribution: The harness does not copy OpenLayers source; package installation remains external and pinned.
sources.update: Re-run the renderer proof and review API/lockfile/license changes on any version update.

sources.name: OpenLayers 10.10.0 package metadata
sources.use: Pinned package version and declared dependency/license metadata.
sources.redistribution: No package files are committed in this research artifact.
sources.update: Resolve and lock transitive dependencies before capture; review the upstream package metadata and notices.

sources.name: OpenLayers WebGL points example
sources.use: Evidence that OpenLayers supplies a WebGL-optimized large-point layer; the proof uses its stable vector API for a controlled comparison.
sources.redistribution: No example source or assets copied.
sources.update: Recheck the supported WebGL layer API when changing the pinned package.

sources.name: MapLibre GL JS CustomLayerInterface
sources.use: Alternative mature WebGL mapping stack and evidence for explicit 2D/3D custom-layer modes, context loss, and render hooks.
sources.redistribution: No MapLibre runtime or source copied.
sources.update: Revisit if OpenLayers lacks required vector-tile/3D behavior after measured proof.

sources.name: WebGL 2.0 specification
sources.use: API contract for the custom WebGL2 candidate.
sources.redistribution: No specification text copied into runtime source.
sources.update: Recheck browser capability and conformance assumptions when changing the runtime target.

sources.name: MDN Performance API data guidance
sources.use: Timing API provenance and limits for the browser proof.
sources.update: Record actual browser API availability in every benchmark result.

sources.name: Vite 8.1.5 package metadata
sources.use: Local-only static module server so the browser resolves the pinned OpenLayers package without external map assets.
sources.redistribution: Vite is installed from the package registry and no bundled runtime files are committed by this research artifact.
sources.update: Review the package license, lockfile integrity, and browser proof when changing the server version.

sources.name: Playwright 1.60.0 package metadata
sources.use: Regular Playwright fallback for retained browser benchmark and screenshot capture because the Browser plugin was unavailable.
sources.redistribution: Playwright package and browser payload remain local ignored tooling; no browser binary is committed or redistributed.
sources.update: Record Browser plugin availability, review package/browser notices, and rerun both viewport matrices on any update.

sources.name: Playwright browser installation documentation
sources.use: Local Chromium acquisition procedure for the reproducible browser proof.
sources.license: Documentation and browser payload retain upstream terms; no payload is redistributed by this harness.
sources.redistribution: The downloaded Chromium/ffmpeg/headless-shell files remain ignored local evidence tooling.
sources.update: Recheck browser version, notices, and runtime provenance when refreshing Playwright browsers.

sources.name: RF Atlas deterministic renderer fixture
sources.redistribution: Original source may be reviewed and redistributed with the repository.
sources.update: Changing the seed or generator requires a new fixture ID and a fresh comparison.
